summary: This change is the 0.1.69 release bump. It updates the desktop package version, pins both production images to 0.1.69 in Pulumi.west.yaml and adds releases/0.1.69.json. The manifest's protocols match the code: workspace client 26 supports [25, 26] and control-plane client 5 supports [3, 5]. Its minimum frontend of 0.1.68 follows releases/README.md, which says the routine cleanup release must retire the 0.1.65 frontend (protocol 24). The validateRelease.mjs checks pass by inspection, the change adds no executable lines, and nothing blocks the release.
